notes.title: Forever Lost is part of Dreamhack Beyond
notes.content:
Dreamhack Beyond is taking place August 18-23, and Forever Lost is participating!

We have an updated demo available to download beefed up with new lighting and art assets. Be sure to play it during the event.

Keep up to date on Forever Lost by following the Altered Gene [url=https://twitter.com/Altered_Gene]Twitter[/url] and joining our [url=https://discord.gg/fvSfV2njXm]Discord[/url].

notes.title: We're also working on a comic book!
notes.content:
This comic book project is going to set up the next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/880790/The_Analyst/]The Analyst[/url] after we ship Forever Lost. 

We are pitching The Analyst around to investors now so that we will (hopefully) have funding to start working on hit once Forever Lost has launched to the public.

The Analyst: Redacted is the first comic book from video game producer, Des Gayle (Life Is Strange, Paradise Killer, Beacon Pines). This project is an extended part of the Section 42 Universe, which is a series of 5 transmedia projects.

In this one-shot, follow the steps of Jane Sommers, an elite operator for the US military as she recounts the fateful classified mission which saw her captured behind enemy lines.

It's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/alteredgene/make-100-the-analyst-redacted?ref=buf97r]live now on Kickstarter[/url] please go and support it!

notes.title: The Mystery Fest is almost over!
notes.content:
Hello!

Forever Lost has been part of the Steam Mystery Fest all week. The event ends tomorrow (Monday 27th February) but we will keep the demo up for another week or so.

This is the first time the demo has been publicly available. Please check it out and you can send feedback via our Discord.

Ciao for now!

Known issues:
The lighting is a bit broken but this won't stop you completing the demo. ːsteamthumbsupː
